risk_definitions.safe: Good candidates for sampling. Likely frontend, design-system, docs, demo, or component-library projects that should be easier to run locally.
risk_definitions.yellow: Usable but risky. May have old dependencies, monorepo complexity, API/backend assumptions, or extra setup.
risk_definitions.red: Avoid unless the PR is important. Likely needs a host platform, backend stack, credentials, mobile emulator, or complex environment.
risk_definitions.dark_red: Strongly avoid for local manual validation. Very large, native, deprecated, archived, or infrastructure-heavy projects.
